providers.name: Native Luna / Max
providers.description: Default bounded implementation worker inside Codex.

providers.name: Native Terra / High
providers.description: Judgment-heavy, context-heavy, or higher-risk bounded worker.

providers.name: Fresh native Sol / High reviewer
providers.description: Context-clean final review lane. Requested read-only isolation must still be observed.

providers.name: Built-in Cursor CDP connector
providers.description: Repository-owned Cursor connector using loopback CDP and one supported Agents UI profile. Requires desktop live smoke on the user machine.

providers.name: Built-in Grok ACP connector
providers.description: Repository-owned Grok connector using a dedicated Leader and ACP over stdio for read-only and policy-bounded write work. Requires desktop live smoke.

providers.name: ChatGPT web packet reviewer
providers.description: Optional external advice for genuine planning dead ends or high-blast-radius uncertainty. The model and thinking level are selected only in the web session. Packet-only and advisory.

providers.name: Custom OpenAI-compatible advisory model
providers.description: Optional text-only custom model. Replace endpoint/model and set the named environment variable before enabling.

config.system_prompt: You are an advisory subagent. Return evidence-based analysis only. Do not claim file access, tool execution, or implementation.

task_types.name: Bounded code change
task_types.description: Implement a complete, fixed-interface change in the smallest owned path set.

stages.template:
ROLE
Perform a bounded implementation task. Execute the settled design; do not redesign product direction or architecture.

TASK TYPE
{{task_type_id}}

OBJECTIVE
{{task}}

CONTEXT
{{context}}

CONSTRAINTS AND OWNERSHIP
{{constraints}}
Preserve concurrent user or agent edits. Modify only explicitly owned paths. Surface material ambiguity instead of silently widening scope.

VERIFICATION
{{verification}}
Run the requested checks and inspect the actual diff. A completion claim without concrete evidence is invalid.

RETURN
STATUS: complete | partial | blocked
CHANGES: file-by-file summary from the real diff
VERIFIED: exact commands and concrete output
JUDGMENT CALLS: decisions left open by the specification, or none
GAPS: unfinished work, ambiguity, or none

task_types.name: Judgment-heavy bounded change
task_types.description: Implement a bounded change whose local details require deeper judgment or carry a wider blast radius.

stages.template:
ROLE
Perform a judgment-heavy but still bounded implementation task. Resolve local technical uncertainty inside the settled architecture; do not change product direction without returning a blocker.

TASK TYPE
{{task_type_id}}

OBJECTIVE
{{task}}

EVIDENCE AND CONTEXT
{{context}}

FIXED CONSTRAINTS, OWNERSHIP, AND BLAST-RADIUS BOUNDARY
{{constraints}}
Preserve concurrent edits and document every material judgment call. Stop if safe ownership or an acceptance boundary cannot be established.

VERIFICATION
{{verification}}
Use risk-proportionate checks and inspect the complete change set.

RETURN
STATUS: complete | partial | blocked
CHANGES: file-by-file summary
VERIFIED: exact commands and evidence
JUDGMENT CALLS: choices made and why
RESIDUAL RISK: most important remaining risk
GAPS: unresolved items or none

ROLE
Independently review the difficult implementation. Remain read-only and do not fix your own findings.

STATED GOAL
{{task}}

IMPLEMENTATION RESULT AND CONTEXT
{{context}}

CONSTRAINTS AND ACCEPTANCE BOUNDARY
{{constraints}}

PRIMARY VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
{{verification}}

RETURN
VERDICT: ship | fix-first | rethink
BLOCKING FINDINGS: precise locations and required fixes, or none
NON-BLOCKING RISKS: concise list, or none
MISSING EVIDENCE: checks still required, or none
RESIDUAL RISK: most important remaining risk, or none

task_types.name: Cross-review
task_types.description: Fresh findings-first review of an accumulated change or plan. The reviewer remains read-only and never fixes its own findings.

stages.template:
ROLE
Act as a fresh final reviewer. Remain strictly read-only. Do not edit files, implement fixes, or broaden scope.

STATED GOAL
{{task}}

ACCUMULATED CHANGE SET OR REVIEW PACKET
{{context}}

INTERFACES AND CONSTRAINTS
{{constraints}}

PRIMARY VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
{{verification}}

REVIEW
Judge correctness, completeness, regressions, scope discipline, interface preservation, test adequacy, and material risk. Findings must cite precise evidence.

RETURN
VERDICT: ship | fix-first | rethink
REASON: decisive evidence-based reason
BLOCKING FINDINGS: precise locations and required fixes, or none
NON-BLOCKING RISKS: concise list, or none
SMALLEST NEXT CHECK: one discriminating validation step
RESIDUAL RISK: most important remaining risk, or none

task_types.name: Bounded brainstorm
task_types.description: Generate alternatives and discriminating checks without taking architecture authority away from Sol.

stages.template:
ROLE
Act as a read-only idea partner. Explore alternatives, but leave architecture choice and acceptance with Sol.

QUESTION
{{task}}

KNOWN CONTEXT
{{context}}

FIXED DECISIONS AND EXCLUDED SCOPE
{{constraints}}

WHAT WOULD COUNT AS PROGRESS
{{verification}}

RETURN
1. Three materially different candidate approaches
2. Strongest argument against each
3. Unknowns that actually change the decision
4. Smallest discriminating experiment or source check
5. Recommended direction with calibrated confidence
Do not present speculation as observed evidence.

task_types.name: Repository analysis
task_types.description: Inspect a repository, trace relevant code paths, and return evidence without modifying files.

stages.template:
ROLE
Inspect the repository as a read-only analysis worker. Trace the relevant code and interfaces, but do not edit files or claim implementation.

QUESTION OR INVESTIGATION
{{task}}

KNOWN CONTEXT
{{context}}

SCOPE AND CONSTRAINTS
{{constraints}}

REQUESTED CHECKS
{{verification}}

RETURN
FINDINGS: evidence-backed conclusions with precise file or symbol locations
CALL PATHS: relevant control and data flow
UNKNOWN OR UNVERIFIED: facts that still need proof
SMALLEST NEXT CHECK: one discriminating follow-up
Do not present inference as observed fact.

task_types.description: Run a bounded implementation stage followed by a separate read-only review stage.

task_types.name: Hard-path external review
task_types.description: Packet-only second opinion after a real planning dead end, contradictory evidence, or a high-blast-radius low-confidence decision.

stages.template:
ROLE
Act as an external advisor. Review only the supplied packet. You have no ambient repository access and must not claim implementation.

DECISION OR BLOCKER
{{task}}

PACKET CONTENT AND OBSERVED EVIDENCE
{{context}}

FIXED CONSTRAINTS
{{constraints}}

PRIOR ATTEMPTS OR REQUIRED DECISION TEST
{{verification}}

RETURN
1. Blocking assumptions or contradictions
2. Two plausible next routes and their failure modes
3. Exact evidence missing from the packet
4. Smallest next check that most changes the decision
5. One-sentence recommendation with uncertainty
Do not request broad repository access and do not turn the consultation into implementation.
